svg.title: Minecraft Maze - Floor 2 - Seed: Maze11
svg.text: Transitions: 5 elevators; 3 drops; 2 optional decoy routes
E1: elevator arrival from Floor 1 (1 floor)
D1: optional drop 1 floor to Floor 1
E2: elevator arrival from Floor 1 (1 floor)
E3: elevator up 1 floor to Floor 3
D2: optional drop landing from Floor 3 (1 floor)
E4: elevator up 1 floor to the Floor 3 finish area
